claims.statement: Single conditional decoder, implicit useful diversity through winner-only loss, free first move and optional EAS rather than independent decoder population.
Shared instance encoder/bit-conditioned residual decoder, K128 winner gradient with mean reward baseline; EAS changes only conditional layers, FFSP uses separate MatNet branch K24.

Four tasks with separate task/size models;64N or200x8N main construction budgets, total test-set runtimes, rounded TSPzero/heuristic references and absolute FFSP makespan gap; transfer and long warm-start training qualified.

Specialist constructive: each task/scale trained separately, different MatNet scheduling architecture; optional EAS updates conditional parameters while reconstructing whole routes, not a neural incumbent edit operator.
